history.sg_progress: The Administration has completed a preliminary review of the 17 cases of potential outside activity identified by the Board. In that review, it determined that two of the individuals referenced by the Board were not, in fact, engaged as experts on sanctions panels, groups or teams. Of the remaining 15 experts, none had engaged in outside activities without prior disclosure to the United Nations Secretariat during the period of their engagement with the Organization. The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, in consultation with relevant stakeholders, is conducting a broader review of its oversight and compliance mechanisms related to the disclosure obligations of experts of sanctions committees.
